map.通过Cooper 12分钟跑测试估算最大摄氧量(VO2max)。公式：VO2ma: Estimate VO2max from a Cooper 12-minute run test using VO2max = (distance − 504.9) / 44.73, with several running-test methods supported.

Cooper 12-minute run: record the maximum distance covered in 12 minutes. 1.5-mile run: record the time to complete 1.5 miles (2400 m).
map.VO2max是最大摄氧量，反映心肺耐力的金标准: VO2max is maximal oxygen uptake, the gold standard for cardiorespiratory endurance
map.VO2max受年龄、性别、训练水平影响: VO2max is affected by age, sex and training level
map.部队体能筛查用 12 分钟跑估 VO2max，大样本低成本初筛有氧水平。: Military fitness screening uses the 12-minute run to estimate VO2max, a large-sample low-cost first screen of aerobic fitness.
map.12 分钟跑 2.4 km → VO2max=22.35×2.4−11.29≈4: 12-minute run of 2.4 km -> VO2max = 22.35×2.4 − 11.29 ≈ 42.6 mL/kg/min (good level).
map.每公斤体重每分钟耗氧毫升数，越高有氧能力越强。: Milliliters of oxygen per kilogram of body weight per minute; higher means better aerobic capacity.
map.Cooper 和跑步机测差多少？: How much does the Cooper run differ from a treadmill test?
map.场地法为估测，受跑姿与动机影响，比实验室法低约 5–10%，宜作趋势看。: The field method is an estimate, affected by running form and motivation; it reads about 5-10% lower than lab methods, so use it for trends.
The VO2max estimator estimates maximal oxygen uptake from Cooper running tests, supporting both the 12-minute run and the 1.5-mile run, and rates fitness level against age- and sex-based reference standards.
